name: Plastics Processing Corporation
old_description: At Plastic Processing , we feature a high tech production facility that is flexible and quickly adaptable to meet your specific needs. Our manufacturing capabilities span a broad range of products and industries.
about:
Plastics Processing Corporation operates from a facility on South Estrella Street in Gardena, California, as the trade name of Narayan Corporation. The company presents itself as a high-tech production shop that is flexible and quickly adaptable to specific customer needs, though no founding year or founder names appear in its public materials.

The core operation centers on blow-molded HDPE and PVC bottles produced on a veteran Beckum machine supplemented by newer equipment. The shop handles both custom mold development and stock bottle lines, accepting orders that range from single cases to full pallets and bulk quantities across what it describes as a broad range of products and industries.

Specific industries served or named customers are not disclosed, but the company positions itself to serve buyers who need flexible volume options, from prototype runs to larger production lots. The business model emphasizes responsiveness to varying order sizes and mold requirements.

Management highlights creative cost-saving ideas that aim to maintain quality while reducing lead times, framing the facility's adaptability as its primary differentiator. The pitch centers on the ability to switch between custom and stock work without sacrificing turnaround.
